notes.title: Patch 0.1.5.2
notes.notes:
Patch 0.1.5.2

What’s New:
[list]
[*]     Crafting Tweaks – Fixed bugs that messed with crafting logic, door open logic and farm function. Placing a harvest spot near multi-resource zones now gives the correct work speed boost. 
[*]     God Mode Added – Toggle God Mode to build instantly and summon zombies at will. 
[/list]
